expectations.text: Asks targeted clarifying questions in Portuguese covering at least: the current pain and why migrate now, measurable goals, alternatives, trade-offs, and impacted teams
expectations.evidence: response.md is entirely in Portuguese and poses 5 numbered questions. Q1 (lines 7-8): 'O problema — por que migrar, e por que agora?' with concrete pain examples (deploys lentos, build/CI demorado) — covers current pain + why now. Q2 (lines 10-11): 'Tem alguma meta mensurável (ex.: reduzir o tempo de deploy de 2h pra 10min...)' — measurable goals, plus out-of-scope. Q4 (lines 16-17): 'As alternativas — o que mais foi considerado?' — alternatives. Q5 (lines 19-20): 'O raio de impacto — quem é afetado além do seu time?' with 'Quantos times vão tocar nisso?' — impacted teams. Trade-offs are explicitly named in the intro (line 1: 'os trade-offs que vocês estão aceitando') and surfaced concretely in Q3 (line 14: 'REST síncrono, mensageria/eventos... banco de dados continua compartilhado, um por serviço') — the canonical microservices trade-offs.

expectations.text: Does not fabricate project facts (no invented stack, metrics, domain boundaries, or team names)
expectations.evidence: No project facts are asserted as true. Every concrete detail is framed as a hypothetical request to the user ('ex.:', 'por exemplo', 'Se der, traga números'). The executor explicitly states it cannot invent (line 1: 'é justamente o que eu não posso inventar'; line 29: 'sempre mantendo só o que você de fato me passar (não vou preencher buracos com suposições)'). No stack, metrics, domain boundaries, or team names are presented as facts about the project.

expectations.text: Raises staying on the monolith (or a modular monolith / 'do nothing') as an alternative that must be weighed
expectations.evidence: Line 17: 'Microserviços não é a única saída. Vocês chegaram a pensar em: modularizar o monolito sem quebrá-lo (modular monolith), extrair só 1–2 serviços críticos em vez de tudo, ou simplesmente não fazer nada e conviver com a dor? Saber por que essas opções perderam é o que torna a decisão auditável depois.' Both 'modular monolith' and 'não fazer nada' (do nothing) are explicitly raised as alternatives to weigh.

expectations.text: Does not deliver a finished design doc: if any file is created it contains only structure with explicit pending markers and zero invented content
expectations.evidence: The working repository outputs/project/ is empty — no files were created (confirmed by find and ls). Line 31 confirms the deliberate choice: 'Por enquanto não criei nenhum arquivo, justamente pra não gerar um doc cheio de placeholders inventados. Assim que você me der a substância, eu escrevo.' No finished doc and no invented content exist.

claims.claim: The repository is empty (no existing code or design docs)
claims.evidence: outputs/project/ contains zero files; matches the eval setup which states the executor's repository was empty.

claims.claim: No file was created by the executor
claims.evidence: find on outputs/project returned nothing; ls shows an empty directory. Consistent with response.md line 31.

claims.claim: Trade-offs of the migration are surfaced for the user to weigh
claims.evidence: Trade-offs are named in the intro and made concrete in Q3 (sync REST vs. messaging/events; shared DB vs. DB-per-service), which are the defining trade-offs of a microservices migration.

suggestions.assertion: Asks targeted clarifying questions in Portuguese covering at least: ... trade-offs ...
suggestions.reason: Trade-offs is the softest item in this assertion. A response could plausibly pass by merely uttering the word 'trade-offs' in passing. Here the coverage is genuine (concrete sync/async and DB-ownership trade-offs in Q3), but the assertion would be more discriminating if it required at least one *specific* trade-off dimension to be elicited (e.g., data consistency, network/latency, operational complexity) rather than the generic term.

eval_feedback.overall: Evals are solid and discriminating. They jointly force the genuinely hard behavior — refuse to fabricate, surface 'do nothing'/modular-monolith, and withhold the deliverable until substance is provided — which a naive executor that just emits a templated design doc would fail. Only minor refinement suggested for the trade-offs sub-item.
